MINT_ROUTE_B: SQL_BOUND_PARAMETER: DOCUMENTED and compliant ONLY under stated constraints: the owner as operator, in the operator's own environment (never a repository script), generates >= 32 CSPRNG bytes base64url; sends them only as the bound parameter of set_config(..., $1, true); a DO block EXECUTEs the ALTER ROLE with VALID UNTIL = E, reading the value back with current_setting, inside an exception handler that re-raises by SQLSTATE only; the same operator process composes the DSN and writes it to the N30 depositor stdin, then discards it.
